name: Idris Falcão-Szczepański
description: Idris Falcão-Szczepański was a rising Vantablack neural-feed star known for a rare quality in his performances — audiences reported his emotional feed produced genuine involuntary laughter responses, a neurological effect that most neural actors can only approximate. Of Brazilian-Polish heritage with extensive facial geneware modifications, he was cast in three major Vantablack productions between 2210 and 2213 before abruptly disappearing mid-production on *The Vertical Compact* sequel. Vantablack released a statement citing 'contract dissolution by mutual agreement,' which no one in the industry believed.
cultural_impact: His disappearance sparked the 'Falcão question' in entertainment labor circles — a shorthand for asking what rights a performer retains over their own neural signature once it has been commercially archived.
story_hooks: Someone claims to have met Falcão-Szczepański living under a different name in the Gray Zone — but the man they describe has no geneware modifications and no memory of his career.

A new Vantablack neural-feed production features a performer whose 'laugh response' quality is identical to Falcão-Szczepański's — raising the question of whether his archived signature is being used without him.
A lawyer specializing in BCI contract law approaches the players with a case that could establish performer rights over neural archives — and needs someone to find Falcão-Szczepański to testify.
